In Technology & SaaS, quantum & advanced compute is the frontier tower, run with a pragmatist's discipline. That is the baseline pattern; the differentiator is what it connects to: quantum readiness & strategy, quantum optimization for enterprise problems, post-quantum cryptography migration — delivered on Dataq Quanta and Dataq Sentinel with the sector's regulatory posture built in.

items: A quantum plan that survives a CFO: inventory, risk clocks and sequenced roadmaps.
Routing, scheduling, portfolios and formulations: hybrid solvers beating classical baselines.

QML and simulation pilots with industrial honesty: real baselines, real data, real verdicts.

blocks.x: Two regimes anchor the control design here: SOC 2 / ISO 27001 and GDPR/CCPA. Customer-data processing, DPAs and subprocessor duties. Evidence for both is generated by the delivery itself — control tests, replay trails and documentation are artifacts of the program, not a reconstruction project.

Programs run on a fixed rhythm so progress is visible from week one. Weeks 1–2 lock the baseline: the current metric is measured with your team and signed before build starts. Weeks 3–8 deliver the pilot on bounded scope — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — with a control owner named on your side. Weeks 9–12 industrialize what worked: runbooks, monitoring, enablement and a measured delta against the signed baseline. Anything that misses its gate is stopped or redirected with a documented decision, not quietly extended.
